kontakt_version: Kontakt version required by the installed Shreddage 3.5 Archtop patch

source.octave_convention: Kontakt manual convention: C-2 = MIDI note 0; C0 = 24; C3 = 60
source.notes: This profile uses the documented default TACT key assignments. Per-articulation mappings are customizable in the instrument, so changed user mappings will not match this profile.

octave_convention: Kontakt manual convention: C-2 = MIDI note 0; C0 = 24; C3 = 60

kontakt_setup.string_channel_order: Guitar Pro string 1 (highest pitch) -> MIDI channel 1; string 6 (lowest pitch) -> MIDI channel 6
kontakt_setup.mapping_scope: Default TACT articulation keys only; additional behavioral, FX, picking, and strumming keys are documented but are not emitted automatically by GP Bridge.

palm_mute.evidence: The manual maps the Mute articulation to C#0 and states that its mute degree is controlled by velocity.

staccato.evidence: The manual maps short unmuted notes to the Staccato articulation at D0.

tremolo.evidence: The manual maps rapid repeated picking to the Tremolo articulation at F#0.

natural_harmonic.evidence: The manual maps Natural Harmonics to G#0.

artificial_harmonic.evidence: The manual maps Artificial Harmonics to A0.

tapping.evidence: The manual maps the Tapping articulation to A#0 and describes it as hammer-on-only playback.

slide.evidence: The manual assigns C1 to the dedicated slide transition between the current note and the next note.

vibrato.evidence: The manual identifies modwheel CC1 as a selectable vibrato controller; this mapping assumes the patch is configured for CC1.

bend.evidence: The manual sets the default MIDI pitch-bend range to plus or minus two semitones. GP bend heights are normalized as percentages of a full step by the converter, then rendered as an upward-only timed pitch-wheel curve; 25 and 50 represent 0.5 and 1 semitone, with a +2 semitone clamp.

hammer_on.evidence: The manual triggers hammer-on transitions through overlapping notes on the same string; the converter adds the configured short overlap.

pull_off.evidence: The manual triggers pull-off transitions through overlapping notes on the same string; the converter adds the configured short overlap.

ambiguities.reason: A generic Guitar Pro harmonic marker defaults to Artificial Harmonics (A0 / MIDI 33), because the marker does not identify Natural Harmonics. Use an explicit Natural Harmonic marker when G#0 / MIDI 32 is intended.

The manual says velocity controls mute depth. This profile preserves Guitar Pro velocity without a custom velocity curve; confirm the patch's TACT velocity mapping if a specific mute depth is required.

articulation_keyswitches.sustain_and_rake: C0 (MIDI 24); Sustain defaults to velocity 1-119 and Rake to 120-127

behavioral_and_fx_keyswitches.force_string: C-2 through F-2 (MIDI 0-5), lowest E/string 6 upward
